reason: Riset hanya memberi bentuk binatang generik (c11), aksi mengintip jendela atap (c04), dan tafsir belakangan tiga jari berkuku tajam (c12); tidak menetapkan kepala, wajah, tubuh, kulit, jumlah anggota badan atau atribut pembeda yang cukup. Ilustrasi sangar terperinci akan mengarang anatomi iblis; tidak ada manifestasi aktif non-anatomis yang cukup spesifik. Decline sesuai GAMBAR§6.5.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_requirements.description: Only generic beast form and three sharp-nailed fingers documented; defining bodily anatomy insufficient.

artistic_choices: No image generated rather than invent identifiable demon anatomy from the generic beast term.
